page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn1.medium is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz. It features 2 vCPUs derived from 1 physical core with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The instance is configured with 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor with dedicated CPU allocation. There is no local NVMe or SSD storage bundled with this instance, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 0 Gbps.

Benchmark evaluations place the performance of the ecs.sn1.medium in the lower tiers. The single-core CPU performance measured via stress-ng is 1097.68, categorized as weak, while the multi-core CPU performance drops to a poor rating at 1455.38. Memory bandwidth tests show 81.52 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 10.27 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. Geekbench scores reflect this trend, with a single-core score of 913.0 and a multi-core score of 1064.0. Database operations and web serving throughput are also limited, with Passmark database operations scoring 544.12 and static web serving throughput reaching 1.25 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is its constrained resource profile and lower-tier processing speeds, which limit its utility for resource-intensive applications. However, the dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent, non-burstable performance within its hardware limits. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.sn1.medium represents an entry-level tier suitable for lightweight workloads that do not require high memory density or local storage. Appropriate workloads include basic web serving, lightweight Redis caching, simple text processing, and low-demand utility tasks.
